## python/v1.61.1

_Auto-drafted from commits in `python/v1.61.0..python/v1.61.1`, grouped by conventional-commit type. Edit on the release page after publish if you want a polished writeup; the canonical release notes live on the website._

### 🐛 Fixes

- fix(bedrock): drop reasoning blocks the target model rejects when history crosses model families (#5166) (5cb880559)
- fix(subagent): surface the child's stop reason instead of masking blocked runs as success (#5165) (ab88efd81)
- fix(context): keep removal markers and summaries out of message 0 (#5121) (47fb500af)
- fix(harness): send adaptive thinking to Claude Haiku 5.5 (#5159) (83a4b0cce)
- fix(python): preserve tool result adjacency with injected context (#5158) (fde126c50)
- fix(offloader): return portable filename from TS FileStorage.store (#4668) (91c9430ef)
- fix: text content block is silently dropped when a toolUse is pending in the same content block stop (#4004) (#4067) (c99665b80)

### 📚 Documentation

- docs(migrate): verify and revise the LangGraph migration guide (#4536) (d6b83a0b2)
- docs(site): redraw docs diagrams as theme-aware SVGs (#5135) (43ccafa08)
- docs(blog): announce Gemma 4 Strands Decider models (#5080) (5538a5cd3)
